resolutions.decision: Open Decision lifecycle and resolution governance (Decision #17): Seven states. Reopening is always explicit; silent reopen prohibited. SUPERSEDED terminal with lineage. Decision records carry no authority fields. Single resolution. Concurrent proposals serialized. Irreversible/compliance → HUMAN_GATE mandatory.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications; explicit reopen; lineage preserved.

resolutions.decision: Conformance and certification model (Decision #16): Conformance (continuous) ≠ Certification (bounded, versioned). Neither grants authority. Cert bound to definition+version; time-bounded expiry; enumerated invalidation triggers. Transitive/blanket prohibited. Certifier INDEPENDENCE_CONTRACT per ADR-035.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications; cert ≠ authority; no transitive cert.

resolutions.decision: Audit chain and event ordering (Decision #15): Three ordering dimensions (CAUSAL primary, INGESTION secondary, OBSERVED advisory). Wall-clock never primary. Hash chain + signatures for tamper-evidence. Per-scope chains with cross-scope pointers. Audit is evidence, never authority.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 9 falsifications; clock-skew resistant; audit never grants authority.

resolutions.decision: Idempotency and deduplication model (Decision #14): Idempotency ≠ dedup. Explicit idempotency keys at effect boundaries. Same intent = same key; new intent = new key; identity conflict rejected. Dedup recognizes, never erases; ATTEMPT lineage and audit history preserved.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 9 falsifications; effect-boundary identity; append-only preserved.

resolutions.decision: Merge ownership and integration authority (Decision #12): Three distinct roles (Proposer, Authorizer, Integrator). Producing artifact must never imply authority to integrate. Explicit INTEGRATION_AUTHORIZATION derived from LAYER 2/3. Workflow: PROPOSE→PREFILIGHT→VERIFY→AUTHORIZE→EXECUTE→RECORD→RE-EVALUATE. Cross-project DPT-mediated.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 8 falsifications; producer≠integrator; authority explicitly derived.

resolutions.decision: Authority persistence and evaluation model (Decision #7): Five-layer authority stack. Evaluator is AUTHORITY_EVALUATOR_SERVICE_INSTANCE. Core invariant: authority persistence ≠ persistent runtime permission. Per-attempt materialization; specific overrides general mode.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test separated 5 layers (policy, delegation, envelope, runtime effective, materialized permissions) with distinct lifetimes. Falsifications survived: 5 layers are distinct, LAYER 5 is never persistent, evaluator is deterministic SERVICE, durable policy authorizes materialization not runtime permission.

resolutions.decision: Gateway and Trust Boundary (Decision #5): Gateway is a SERVICE + GATEWAY_SERVICE_INSTANCE; not an AGENT. Enforces boundary policy only (identity, authn mTLS, authz envelope, isolation, audit signed, direct-access rejection allowlist). Orchestrator enforces execution policy. Gateway never holds canonical state, never originates policy, never grants authority. Deprecated term: 'Gateway Agent'.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved the 'Gateway Agent' misnomer (violates ADR-029 determinism routing), boundary vs execution policy conflation, audit non-repudiation, and allowlist-based direct-access rejection. Falsifications survived: semantic intent interpretation is Orchestrator's role; non-deterministic envelope input fails closed; multi-instance HA is a deployment concern not a model concern.

resolutions.decision: Front Agent Lifecycle (Decision #4): lifecycle states PROVISIONING/INITIALIZING/ONLINE/DEGRADED/RECONNECTING/SUSPENDED-BLOCKED/UPDATING/REVOKING/RETIRED. Multi-instance only with non-overlapping authority scopes or active/standby lease. Fail-closed on queue/resource exhaustion. Scout is sibling ROLE. Recovery respects distributed state ownership.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved contradictions in provisioning, identity, update control, persistence, offline behavior, isolation, and reconnect. Final corrections applied: Scout as sibling, fail-closed suspension, distributed ownership recovery, bounded multi-instance rule.

resolutions.decision: Capability, Role, Agent, Service Ontology (Decision #3): AGENT_DEFINITION as design-time reusable/versioned contract; AGENT_INSTANCE as runtime instantiation; ROLE may be fulfilled by AGENT_INSTANCE/SERVICE_INSTANCE/HUMAN/WORKFLOW; Orchestrator is SERVICE + spawned COORDINATION_REASONING ROLE; Independent verification enforced via INDEPENDENCE_CONTRACT (REASONING_ISOLATION + EVIDENCE_INDEPENDENCE minimum).
resolutions.rationale: Stress tests exposed scoring-model arbitrariness, conflation of agent definition vs instance, and miscategorization of independent verification. Falsifications survived for determinism routing, role pluralism, orchestrator decomposition, and model/provider non-binding.

resolutions.decision: Runtime intent intake format adopts DPT Work Order contract
resolutions.rationale: ADR-027 (Durable task state) + ADR-020 (six modes) define the canonical intake. Intent = WorkOrder with envelope, mode, and resource claims.

resolutions.decision: Orchestrator transport: in-process RPC via CapabilityGateway, no network protocol freeze
resolutions.rationale: ADR-024/026 require conservative conflict handling. Transport is implementation detail; gateway is the single enforcement point.

resolutions.decision: Persistent memory: bounded to TASKS.md durable store with JSON records, TTL support
resolutions.rationale: ADR-027 mandates durable task state as canonical store. Memory is a bounded projection, not a separate database.

resolutions.decision: Workflow lifecycle: BACKLOG→READY→RUNNING→REWORK→CLOSED with deterministic transition guards
resolutions.rationale: Lifecycle states BOUND per DPT-RECON-003. Mechanism: state machine with explicit VALID_TRANSITIONS map.

resolutions.decision: Quality gates: configurable predicate pipeline, gate definitions as first-class artifacts
resolutions.rationale: ADR-025 (Verification is first-class) mandates gates as auditable predicates, not hard-coded checks.

resolutions.decision: Routing taxonomy: capability, risk, authority, environment, data sensitivity, cost
resolutions.rationale: Execution Control Model defines routing dimensions. Exact enum TBD per real-project evidence.

resolutions.decision: Greenfield advisory flow (Decision #18): Bounded pipeline INTAKE_RECEIVED -> ACCEPTED_BY_OWNER -> TRANSFERRED_TO_PROJECT. Advisory Plane never executes, never grants authority, never instantiates capabilities. Mandatory Human Gate at BLUEPRINT_PROPOSED. ASSEMBLY_RECOMMENDATION (Advisory) distinct from ASSEMBLY_INSTANTIATION (Execution, Authority-gated). Scout has no role pre-project. Cross-project reuse only via CONTRIBUTION_CANDIDATE path.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications (silent execution, authority grant, pre-project Scout, single intake form, Human Gate bypass, advisory state lifecycle, cross-project leakage, assembly = instantiation, greenfield creates authority, advisory record leakage).

resolutions.decision: Proactive DPT notification model (Decision #19): Subscription-gated, advisory-only, severity-prioritized, throttled, connection-state-bounded. NOTIFY_* kinds per ADR-032. SEVERITY_PRECLINICAL/NOTIFY/URGENT tiers. PROJECT_SUBSCRIPTION declares accepted_kinds, severity_floor, per-kind throttle/suppress, routing_target. PROACTIVE_NOTIFICATION advisory_only=true invariant. No notification may trigger Task/Agent/claim/lease/Authority. Front Agent state (ADR-030) gates fanout. Cross-project reuse only via CONTRIBUTION_CANDIDATE.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications (notification=execution, push without consent, implicit promise, auto-install, authority bypass, spam, security non-prioritized, silence=consent, contribution leakage, fanout after retirement).

resolutions.decision: Project intelligence update triggers (Decision #20): 3 trigger classes (TRIGGER_SCHEDULED/EVENT/SIGNAL). 2 refresh modes (REFRESH_TARGETED default, REFRESH_BROAD on threshold breach). Project-tunable BROAD_RESCAN_THRESHOLD. Trigger budget 20/day. Dedup window 4h. Connection-state-gated per ADR-030. Broad rescan produces INTELLIGENCE_VERSION_N+1 with supersedes lineage (ADR-043). Scout: SERVICE_INSTANCE for targeted, ROLE_INSTANCE for broad/judgment (ADR-029).
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications (time-only, every-change-full-rescan, Scout=AGENT, trigger=action, hard-coded, cross-project leak, triggers after RETIRED, authority bypass, trigger storm, broad destroys prior).

resolutions.decision: DPT update propagation model (Decision #21): 8 UPDATE_* kinds (PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR/SECURITY/DEPRECATION/REMOVAL/INTELLIGENCE/PITFALL). PROPAGATION_RECORD with asset_version, compatibility_range, compatibility_break, deprecation_until, migration_guide_ref, requires_owner_review, severity_tier, audit_chain_ref. Mandatory COMPATIBILITY_BREAK + MIGRATION_GUIDE_REF + DEPRECATION_UNTIL triplet for breaking changes. DPT never modifies project code. Subscription-gated per ADR-045. Audit-chained per ADR-041. Deprecation != removal. Cross-project = asset-level metadata only per ADR-009.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications (propagation=execution, implicit acceptance, DPT modifies code, no version pinning, deprecation=removal, migration=command, no subscription, project state leak, no audit, silent compatibility break).

resolutions.decision: DPT Network API contract (Decision #22): Transport-independent; canonical API_MESSAGE envelope. AUTHENTICATION != AUTHORIZATION (per ADR-033). Internal vs External surfaces. Codec-neutral schema registry. Transport = adapter (deferred). Per-caller rate limits with URGENT bypass. All mutations require idempotency_key (ADR-040). Offline sync: advisory=LAST_WRITER_WINS, authority=conflict-via-authority-chain, audit=append-only, PI=SUPERSEDED with lineage (ADR-043).
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications (mandatory transport, API carries authority, single transport, auth=authz, URL versioning, no rate limits, retries duplicate, offline undefined, JSON-only, DPT-internal-only).

resolutions.decision: DPT Pool architecture (Decision #23): 8 POOL_* types (COMPONENT/MODULE/SKILL/AGENT_DEFINITION/PITFALL/PATTERN/DECISION_EVIDENCE/DECISION). Pool stores design-time definitions, NOT runtime instances (ADR-029). 5-state lifecycle. 3 validation tiers (ADR-042). 6 mandatory compatibility dimensions. Capability-routed discovery (ADR-039). Audit-chained mutations (ADR-041). Pool public-by-design, Project Intelligence project-private (ADR-009). Re-publish from DEPRECATED creates new version (ADR-043).
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications (flat bag, unidirectional lifecycle, no validation tier, semver-only, binary compat, unranked discovery, no audit, project-visible default, project-specific in pool, missing dimensions).

resolutions.decision: DPT Credit Economy Architecture (Decision #24): Credits = internal governance abstraction, NOT real currency (no fiat conversion). Economy advisory-only, built on ADR-033 authority envelope. All unit costs/rewards CONFIGURABLE_WITH_DEFAULTS — TBD pending real-project evidence. Free period = temporary access, revert on expiry (no permanent entitlement). Subscription tiers = feature flags + request limits (no architecture change). Anti-abuse rules EMIT ABUSE_INDICATOR events (never silent). Validation × economy independent (ADR-042). Cross-project transfer gated by CONTRIBUTION_CANDIDATE approval (ADR-042). Audit-chained via ECONOMY_MUTATION_RECORD (ADR-041). Explicitly UNRESOLVED: reward magnitudes, cost rates, request limits, abuse thresholds.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications (credits=money, economy=enforces execution, hard-coded prices, free period permanent, tier changes architecture, silent anti-abuse, validation=economic, free transfer, limits=throttle, economy drifts silently).

resolutions.decision: DPT API Monetization Model (Decision #25): Monetization = policy-layer mapping between API methods and credit consumption rules (ADR-050). DPT API does NOT process payments; emits MONETIZED_OPERATION_RECORD (ADR-041). Rate limits ≠ quotas (two independent mechanisms). Pricing visibility: OWNER_ONLY default. All monetization decisions versioned per ADR-043. External billing out of scope. Unresolved: credit_cost_per_operation values (CONFIGURABLE_WITH_DEFAULTS, TBD).
resolutions.rationale: Stress test resolved 10 falsifications (monetization=billing, bypass tiers, public pricing, API is payment processor, free tier needs payment info, unversioned decisions, internal=external pricing, silent monetized ops, rate limit=quota, monetization changes API surface).

resolutions.decision: DPT Runtime/Packaging and Execution Persistence (Decision #26): DEFERRED. Implementation-tier choices explicitly listed as non-goals in DPT_OPEN_DECISIONS.md (runtime, database schema, queue, lock service, agent-provider integration). Architecture = intentional deferral per spec-first mode. No ADR created. Revisit when: Foundation work produces project-side agent artifacts, ≥1 real deployment provides persistence pattern data, governance review confirms stability.
resolutions.rationale: Stress test confirmed: decision describes concrete implementation details (packaging mechanism, persistence model, deployment target) that are explicitly prohibited from premature freezing by the document's own non-goals clause. Canonicalizing implementation would violate spec-first mode and the component-first principle (premature runtime introduction before core model validated).
